units.source_text: 藤壶皇后决定迁居三条的私邸中。

en.t: Empress Fujitsubo decided to move to her private residence at Sanjo.

units.source_text: 前来迎接她的是其兄兵部卿亲王。

en.t: The one who came to escort her was her elder brother, Prince Hyobukyo.

units.source_text: 其时大雪纷飞，北风凛冽。

en.t: At that time heavy snow was whirling down, and the north wind was bitterly cold.

units.source_text: 宫中人影渐渐稀少，景象异常萧条。

en.t: Within the palace, people gradually became scarce, and the scene was unusually desolate.

units.source_text: 源氏大将特来相伴，闲话桐壶院在世时情状。

en.t: General Genji came especially to keep her company, and they spoke quietly of how things had been when Kiritsubo院 was still alive.

units.source_text: 兵部卿亲王望见庭中的五叶松在雪中凋零，下面的叶已经枯萎，便吟诗道：

en.t: Prince Hyobukyo saw the five-needle pine in the garden withering in the snow, its lower leaves already dried, and recited this poem:
